text:
Marco: ran a 12h continuous-batcher perf sweep on prod-sim, throwing the new kernel-affinity mapper at mixed traffic. interesting outcomes: when decode-rate > ~520 tok/s we see kernel flip & tail latency spikes; KV hit rate drops ~6% for prompts > 1k tokens; short prompts (<=40) get delayed forming batches (~12-18ms extra).
Ashley: can you dump the flame and the admission counters?
Marco: pasted the key bits below:
```
flame: /tmp/flame-run-2026-03-16.svg
admission: admit_window_ms=8, soft_headroom=24, max_token_budget=2048
kernel_affinity_map: short->fastfp16, mid->int8gptq, long->fallback_fp32
kv_stats: hit_rate_short=98.4%, hit_rate_mid=96.1%, hit_rate_long=89.7%
decode_rate_buckets: [<200,200-520,>520]
```
Ravi: hmm the kernel flip aligns with decode_rate >520 bucket. my guess: the classifier is misrouting some mid-length prompts into mid->int8gptq, which then trips a kernel hotswap when combined with high decode throughput -> OS scheduling jitter.
Anu: can we repro with a controlled replay? i want to see if it's scheduling or the kernel itself.
Marco: did a replay on a 4xA10 sim, risk-repro: kernel handoff occurs after ~3.8k concurrent tokens, reproducible. attaching short snippet of the admission log:
```
[03-16T14:10:12Z] queue_len=11, batch_TokBudget=512, selected_kernel=int8gptq
[03-16T14:10:12Z] decode_rate=540 tok/s -> triggering kernel-swap->latency +14ms
[03-16T14:10:12Z] kv_hit_rate drop observed -2.7% over 2s
```
Dylan: may be worth adding a hysteresis window in the classifier when decode-rate toggles buckets rapidly. also prefer soft handoff (keep old kernel for N batches before swap).
Ravi: agree. propose config changes for probe: reduce max_token_budget for short prompts to 32 to improve batch formation speed; set soft_headroom to 40ms for rapid decode-rate oscillation cases; add decode-rate stabilization: require bucket condition for 3 consecutive batches before kernel change.
Ashley: can you sketch the JSON for rollout? i'll run it in canary.
Ravi: rollout fragment:
```
{
  "batching": {
    "short_prompt_max_tokens": 40,
    "max_token_budget_short": 32,
    "soft_headroom_ms": 40,
    "decode_rate_hysteresis_batches": 3,
    "kernel_swap_grace_batches": 2
  },
  "classifier": {
    "length_buckets": [40, 512, 2048],
    "decode_rate_buckets": [200, 520]
  }
}
```
Anu: can we also instrument KV prefetch counters per bucket? need to know if prefetch is starving cache for long tails.
Marco: good call — adding per-bucket prefetch_hits/prefetch_misses to the probe.
ops-bot: deploy request: canary/eng-runtime/kern-handoff-hysteresis v1 scheduled by Ashley at 2026-03-17T02:00Z :white_check_mark:
Ashley: starting canary now (small slice on prod-sim). will watch latency, kv_hit_rate, and kernel_swap metrics for the next 6 hours.
Dylan: if canary shows reduction in kernel-swaps and tail latency but slight drop in throughput, that's acceptable. keep an eye on cost delta. :eyes:
Marco: next steps: run canary -> collect per-bucket prefetch stats -> iterate on max_token_budget thresholds. will report back in ~12h. :+1:
